title: About Aquemi: pharmaceutical water, built in Canada | Aquemi
meta: One Canadian team designs, builds, FAT tests, qualifies and services your modular Purified Water (PW) package to USP <645> and <643>. Meet the people.
headline: Pharmaceutical water, one Canadian team
lead: We work only on Purified Water (PW) for regulated manufacturing: one modular package, from URS to requalification.

facts.l: Border crossings, our shop to a Canadian site

primary_cta_intent: Not sure yet: talk to an engineer

items.d: We start from your user requirement specification and a feed water analysis, and size the system for your measured demand.
PP skids with PVC pretreatment are built in our shop in [city], joined by [PP joining method, for example butt fusion or IR welding], with traceable materials.
Every system is factory acceptance tested with water before it ships, to a protocol you approved.
We execute SAT and IQ/OQ on site, and support your PQ.
Service, spare parts, calibration and requalification support for the life of the system.

blocks.h: One team from URS to requalification
blocks.intro: No agent, no FAT abroad, no package assembled from three suppliers.

items.d: Process and automation engineers turn your URS and feed water into the specification, P&IDs and traceability.
[PP joining qualification] fabricators build the PP system to [PP piping standard]; [PP joint records kept].
The engineers who wrote the specification run the wet FAT. Deviations close before shipping.
Our validation lead runs SAT and IQ/OQ. Your quality unit approves every protocol first.
Technicians take over with the as-built drawings, FAT results and the engineers who made them.

items.q: You are smaller than the global manufacturers. Why take the risk?
items.a: Judge on evidence, not size: audit our quality system, witness a FAT, read a sample turnover package, call a reference. [financial standing evidence for procurement]

items.q: What happens to our system if a key person leaves?
items.a: The knowledge sits in the records: specification, as-built drawings, fabrication records, FAT and qualification reports, change history. A replacement engineer works from the same records.

items.q: Do you work outside pharmaceutical manufacturing?
items.a: Our RO and EDI platforms also serve hospital reprocessing water (CSA Z314) and laboratory water (CLSI GP40, ASTM D1193). No residential or municipal products.

items.q: Do you service systems you did not build?
items.a: Yes, for [makes and equipment types serviced], starting with a condition survey. No Aquemi serial number is needed.
